title: (2nd LD) S. Korea, U.S. agree to postpone key bilateral security dialogue to early next year: Seoul
caption:
South Korea and the U.S. have rescheduled their major security summit to early 2027. The move comes amid continued debates over the conditions required for Seoul to take over wartime operational control.
